test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.**

The minute you start _______ and tolerating __________, it becomes the new norm and the slide begins and therefore, we must constantly __________ to give our best and be recognised, not simply aim to do just enough to ___________ that we don’t get found out.
solution:
The correct answer is **'****compromising, mediocrity, strive, ensure**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• From the given incomplete passage, we can infer from the beginning part that it is talking about how* if we start tolerating something negative *it becomes the new norm.
 
• Thus, the second blank will have a word that implies a negative trait. 
 
• From the given options let us look into the meanings of *each second word* -
 
 
• 
 
 
 

 **Option**
 **Second Word**
 **Meaning**
 
 

 1
 excellence
 the quality of being outstanding or extremely good.
 
 

 2
 mediocrity
 the quality or state of being mediocre.
 
 

 3
 transcendence
 existence or experience beyond the normal or physical level.
 
 

 4
 distinction
 a difference or a contrast between similar things or people.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above table it is clear that only **mediocrity **is a word that implies a negative trait and it falls under **option 2.**
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the other words under **option 2 - **
 
 
• **​compromising - **expediently accept standards that are lower than is desirable.
 
• **strive - **make great efforts to achieve or obtain something.
 
• **ensure - **make certain that (something) will occur or be the case.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that each word of **option 2 **fits the corresponding blanks correctly. 
 
• Hence **option 2 **is the correct answer. 

**Correct passage__ - ***The minute you start **__compromising__ **and tolerating __**mediocrity**__, it becomes the new norm and the slide begins therefore, we must constantly **__strive__ **to give our best and be recognized, not simply aim to do just enough to **__ensure__ **that we don’t get found out.*
